subject.title: Autoreview rejects safe provider credential references and test placeholders

question: Which exact provider/session member-read expressions and test-only placeholder literals may bypass autoreview’s fail-closed credential detector without creating a reusable bypass for hard-coded secrets?
rationale: The code change is mechanically small, but the permanent scanner boundary determines what sensitive-looking source can pass to an external reviewer and cannot be safely inferred from one contributor’s examples.

options.title: Approve a narrow exact allowlist
options.body: Allow only the concrete session/provider member-read forms and exact test fixture literals documented by the issue, with negative regression cases retained.

options.title: Keep the current fail-closed rule
options.body: Reject these shapes until a broader reviewed secret-classification design is available, accepting the current false-positive cost.

options.title: Adopt a different narrow contract
options.body: Specify alternative exact roots, property paths, or fixture conventions and require the implementation PR to encode only that contract.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow exact allowlist
recommendation.body: Allow only the concrete session/provider member-read forms and exact test fixture literals documented by the issue, with negative regression cases retained.

likelyOwner.reason: Tentative routing to the likely owner of the canonical shared autoreview workflow; repository history could not be fully inspected in this read-only environment.
